#credit #travel

Rules after the 2023 attempt: one new card at most every 6 months, only if the bonus needs spend I'd do anyway, and the balance is cleared in full by direct debit, every month, no exceptions. Amex Preferred Rewards Gold opened 9 Jan 2024: 20,000 Membership Rewards points after £3,000 spend in 3 months, which the Christmas food shop plus the car insurance renewal covered. Converted to 20,000 Avios, used toward Isla's and my Manchester to Málaga flights in Oct 2024 (paid £94.60 in taxes). Closed it 2 Jan 2025 before the £195 annual fee hit. Next on the list: BA Amex (free version) in July 2025, 5,000 Avios after £1,000. Experian score went 961 to 902 after the 2023 hard searches and recovered to 955 by Dec 2024, so it's fine, but don't apply in the 6 months before the remortgage in spring 2026, see [[Mortgage overpayment]]. Every card goes on a line in [[Budget spreadsheet]] with the date the fee is due. Cover that comes with cards is usually rubbish, compare in [[Travel insurance comparison]].
